_doc: Expected output per case id of the input file. A response that differs is a Locust failure (Spec04 §5).

cases.goal: Normal booking at the hub: a random standard car, oil change, random 15-min slot 2–120 days ahead. Expected 201 with the assigned bay + technician, or 409 when that slot is already taken (by load or by the same vehicle).
Idempotent retry: the client times out and sends the SAME request with the SAME Idempotency-Key → the same appointment comes back (201, same id), no second row.
Same vehicle, same time, NEW key → 409: one car cannot be in two bays at once (DB-03), even though the hub has free bays and technicians.
Start in the past → 400 (validator, no DB write).
Outside opening hours: 20:00 local at the hub (open 08:00–17:00) → 400.
Starts inside the hours but ENDS after closing: 16:30 + 60 min at the hub (closes 17:00) → 400. The whole window must fit.
Vehicle not owned by the customer (customer with no vehicle + someone else's hybrid) → 400.
Missing startTime / empty body fields → 400 from bean validation, never a 500 NullPointerException.
Hydrogen car at the hub → 422: no bay or technician there takes the vehicle type, at ANY time (different from 409 'busy now').
Electric truck at the hub → 422: a technician is certified for it, but the hub has no heavy high-voltage bay. Both resources are needed.
Service that no technician anywhere can do (hydrogen fuel-cell service, gasoline car) → 422, not an endless 409.
